new_jobs.description:
Responsibilities

This is for an upcoming future opportunity. This position is part of a proposal effort and is contingent upon contract award. This will be based out of Bethesda, MD.

The Scientist (UNDS) provides scientific research, biological analysis, and technical support to the Naval Surface Warfare Center, Carderock Division (NSWCDD) in the area of Uniform National Discharge Standards (UNDS) program execution. This role applies biological science expertise to support the Navy's compliance with 40 CFR 1700 and related state, federal, and international wastewater management policies affecting Navy vessels and operations.

This position applies scientific methodology, including biological sampling, toxicity testing, bioassay methods, and EPA-approved test methods (40 CFR 136), to discharge characterization, water quality analysis, and regulatory impact assessment. The Scientist coordinates with EPA, state regulatory agencies, Navy program offices, and Fleet units to support requirements development, discharge characterization, and policy compliance for the Navy's UNDS program. The candidate is responsible for UNDS task areas and must apply rigorous QA/QC protocols, laboratory information management systems (LIMS), and Standard Methods for the Examination of Water and Wastewater to ensure scientifically defensible results.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities (UNDS Support) Include

Review state, federal, and international policies and regulations affecting shipboard wastewater discharge management
Summarize regulatory findings in clear, actionable scientific reports for program leadership and stakeholders
Identify and assess the impacts of proposed or enacted regulatory changes on Navy UNDS program compliance obligations
Monitor EPA rulemaking, Congressional legislation, and international conventions (e.g., MARPOL Annex IV) for UNDS relevance
Characterize discharges from Navy vessels using biological sampling, chemical analysis, and physical measurements per 40 CFR Part 1700
Conduct biological sampling, toxicity testing, and bioassay methods to assess discharge characteristics and environmental impacts
Apply EPA-approved test methods (40 CFR 136) and Standard Methods for the Examination of Water and Wastewater for all analytical work
Collect and analyze water quality data from discharge streams aboard Navy vessels; maintain chain of custody and QA/QC protocols
Support preparation of discharge characterization reports and data summaries (CDRL A002)
Coordinate with laboratories and field teams for sampling and analytical services as required; utilize LIMS for data management
Support the development of Navy regulations, policies, and guidelines in response to UNDS requirements
Draft and review UNDS-related policy documents, standards, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) drawing on biological science expertise
Coordinate with NAVSEA, EPA, and Navy program offices to develop scientifically sound regulatory responses
Assist in the preparation of Navy comments on proposed federal and state environmental rulemakings affecting biological and water quality standards
Conduct outreach and awareness training for Navy personnel on UNDS requirements, discharge standards, and compliance procedures
Develop training materials, presentations, and informational resources on biological sampling and water quality for Fleet and program office audiences
Support creation of awareness campaigns and educational content related to shipboard environmental stewardship and discharge management
Deliver training in multiple formats including classroom, aboard ship, and through informational products
Manage supporting documentation arising from UNDS regulatory, policy, sampling, and outreach activities
Track actions and decisions resulting from regulatory reviews, policy development, laboratory analyses, and program meetings
Maintain program records, laboratory data files, and correspondence related to UNDS compliance activities
Prepare status reports and action item logs for program leadership review; ensure QA/QC documentation is current and complete
Plan, coordinate, and attend program reviews, conferences, symposia, and other programmatic and technical meetings related to UNDS work
Prepare agendas, scientific presentation materials, and meeting minutes for UNDS-related events
Represent NSWCDD UNDS program at interagency, Fleet, and external stakeholder forums as appropriate
Track and follow up on action items arising from meetings and technical exchanges
Provide analytical services for laboratory and shipboard/pier-side testing of water and wastewater quality and characterization
Conduct water and wastewater sampling in accordance with EPA-approved test methods (40 CFR 136) and Standard Methods for the Examination of Water and Wastewater
Perform biological, chemical, and physical analytical testing and analyses using calibrated laboratory equipment and instrumentation
Apply statistical validation and QA/QC protocols to all analytical data; document results in LIMS and prepare analytical reports
Support whole effluent toxicity (WET) testing and bioassay studies for discharge characterization
Conduct studies on shipboard environmental systems and shore-side discharge operations
Perform legislative reviews, rulemaking analyses, and international treaty reviews relevant to biological water quality standards
Analyze regulatory documents for their impact and relevance to Navy programs and UNDS compliance
Draft standards and regulations; prepare supporting scientific presentations and briefing materials
Provide scientific data analysis, interpretation of laboratory results, and statistical projections related to discharge characterization and biological sampling
Support UNDS compliance data reporting, trend analysis, and QA/QC reviews of analytical data
Prepare data summaries, charts, and visualizations for program reports and briefings
Write, review, edit, provide comments on, and revise scientific and technical documents including laboratory reports, sampling plans, and SOPs
Develop technical assessments and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for biological sampling and analytical procedures
Review and develop drawings; rewrite/incorporate revisions into existing documents
Attend technical and programmatic meetings; provide minutes and track action items to completion
Arrange, organize, coordinate, schedule, and facilitate events including meetings, program reviews, and symposia
Design and develop informational posters, brochures, specification sheets, and scientific outreach materials

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Biology from an accredited College or University

Shall possess at least approximately five (5) years of experience in work related to Uniform National Discharge Standards (UNDS) and its impact on Navy operations and vessels
Expert knowledge of the Uniform National Discharge Standards (UNDS) regulatory framework under 40 CFR Part 1700, and the underlying Clean Water Act (33 U.S.C.
1322) authorities governing vessel discharges of the Armed Forces
Strong foundation in biology, including microbiology, aquatic biology, or marine biology, as applied to water quality analysis, discharge characterization, biological sampling, and assessment of environmental impacts from shipboard discharges
Proficiency in water and wastewater sampling techniques; skilled in applying EPA-approved test methods (40 CFR 136) and Standard Methods for the Examination of Water and Wastewater for all laboratory and field analyses
Experience with biological sampling, toxicity testing, and bioassay methods (including whole effluent toxicity testing) to characterize vessel discharge streams and assess biological impacts on receiving water bodies
Demonstrated experience implementing QA/QC protocols in laboratory and field settings; proficiency with Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS), chain of custody documentation, and laboratory equipment calibration and maintenance
Proficiency in scientific data analysis, statistical validation, and interpretation of laboratory results; ability to apply quantitative methods to support UNDS compliance reporting and discharge characterization studies
Familiarity with federal environmental statutes (Clean Water Act, NEPA) and international treaties (MARPOL 73/78 Annex IV) applicable to ship waste management and discharge regulation; ability to assess regulatory impacts on Navy biological testing programs
Knowledge of OPNAV-M 5090.1 (Environmental Readiness Program Manual) and relevant Navy environmental policy documents governing shipboard environmental compliance and biological monitoring requirements
Strong scientific writing skills fProficiency with MS Office suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), LIMS, scientific databases, and data analysis tools
preparation of sampling plans, laboratory reports, technical assessments, and regulatory analyses
ability to communicate complex biological and technical findings to diverse stakeholders
Ability to obtain and maintain security clearance

Desired Qualifications

Prior experience supporting Navy or DoD UNDS program execution, particularly in biological sampling or discharge characterization studies
Familiarity with MARPOL 73/78 Annex IV (Sewage from Ships) and International Maritime Organization (IMO) environmental requirements applicable to Navy vessels
Experience with EPA-approved testing procedures per 40 CFR 136 (Guidelines Establishing Test Procedures for the Analysis of Pollutants), including biological and chemical test methods

new_jobs.description:
Required Skills:

Strong SQL, Databricks ( or Snowflake) , Python and PowerBI (reports and dashboard development)
Preferred:
Snowflake, Python

Description:

We are seeking a highly analytical, technically strong, and relentlessly curious Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer to help transform complex, disconnected data into trusted business insights and scalable data solutions.
While strong SQL skills remain essential, success in this role requires a broader capability across Databricks, data engineering, end-to-end analytics, and Power BI development. This role is not limited to querying data—it requires building and optimizing the data foundation, shaping business-ready datasets, and delivering clear, executive-ready reporting and visualization solutions.
The ideal candidate is equally comfortable working across raw data, transformation logic, analytical modeling, and front-end reporting. They enjoy solving difficult problems, thrive in ambiguity, and continuously ask questions to understand not only what happened, but also why it happened, where the data came from, how it should be modeled, and how insights should be delivered to the business in a trusted and scalable way.
This individual should be able to work across the full analytics lifecycle: sourcing and engineering data, understanding lineage and dependencies, designing curated datasets, applying business logic, validating outputs, and delivering insights through dashboards, reports, and executive readouts. They are naturally driven to investigate, learn the business, understand source systems, and uncover relationships across domains that others may overlook.
This role supports strategic business initiatives across Fiber, Connected Communities, Mobility, customer, revenue, operational, and financial domains. The individual is expected to partner closely with business stakeholders, develop a deep understanding of the business, and create scalable, trusted, and well-engineered data and reporting solutions that support executive decision-making.

Key Responsibilities:

Analyze and integrate data across multiple applications, source systems, and business domains.
Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and transformation logic to support analytics and reporting needs.
Develop advanced SQL queries, analytical models, and reconciliation logic to investigate, validate, and unify complex datasets.
Use Databricks to engineer, transform, optimize, and operationalize large-scale datasets for analytical consumption.
Build curated, business-ready datasets that serve as trusted sources for analysis, executive reporting, and self-service consumption.
Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports that translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for business and executive stakeholders.
Own analytics solutions end to end, from raw data ingestion and transformation through semantic logic, reporting, visualization, and insight generation.
Transform fragmented and complex data into clear, business-relevant stories and recommendations.
Identify relationships between customers, products, locations, revenue, operational activity, and business performance.
Partner with business stakeholders to understand objectives, define KPIs and metrics, and solve challenging business problems.
Investigate data quality issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement sustainable fixes in partnership with upstream and downstream teams.
Ensure data lineage, business logic, and transformation rules are documented, scalable, and maintainable.
Improve performance, reliability, and usability of analytical workflows using modern engineering and BI best practices.
Continuously expand business, source system, platform, and reporting knowledge to accelerate problem-solving and improve analytical effectiveness.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role
The strongest individuals in this role are not simply SQL developers, report builders, or dashboard creators. They are end-to-end problem solvers who can connect business needs, data engineering, analytics, and reporting into scalable solutions.
They:
Possess strong analytical curiosity and a desire to deeply understand how the business works.
Have hands-on experience with Databricks, modern data transformation, and analytical data engineering.
Have strong Power BI skills and know how to turn complex analysis into intuitive, executive-friendly dashboards and reporting.
Can connect disparate pieces of information into a complete, accurate, and actionable story.
Are comfortable working through ambiguity and incomplete requirements.
Ask thoughtful questions and challenge assumptions.
Take ownership of finding the right answer, not just the quickest answer.
Understand that trusted analytics begin with well-engineered, validated, and well-modeled data.
Can move seamlessly from raw data to business-ready insight and visualization.
Continuously build expertise in business processes, data lineage, system dependencies, and analytical modeling.
Translate complex technical findings into clear business recommendations and executive-ready outputs.
Demonstrate persistence, intellectual curiosity, and a passion for learning.

JOB LOCATION
Fully Remote (US-based)

ABOUT BEACON DATA
As a full-stack data and growth consulting firm, Beacon leverages machine and human intelligence to help clients achieve breakthrough performance. Organizations don’t just call us to architect smart data strategy – they call us to implement it. As their expert data partner, our cross-functional team parachutes in to optimize data environments, unify fragmented data, and operationalize AI/ML use cases that accelerate growth. At Beacon, impact goes beyond improving the bottom line: one in four of our clients are mission-based organizations.

BEACON PROJECTS No Beacon Project Is Ever The Same; We Work Across Multiple Sectors, Providing Unique Learning And Leadership Opportunities. Examples Include

Stitching together tens of millions of airline customer records to increase loyalty program enrollment
Predicting optimal inventory levels for a supply chain firm to reduce idle time
Optimizing donor targeting for a leading children’s hospital using advanced segmentation
Designing and implementing a modern analytics platform for the largest online theater ticketing company
Applying ML/AI to optimize contact strategies and improve credit card debt recovery outcomes

THE ROLE

Beacon Data is seeking a Senior Data Analyst
to join our data team and support high-impact analytics and business intelligence work for our clients. This is a senior, hands-on analytics role focused on transforming complex data into trusted insights, scalable reporting, and clear recommendations for decision-makers.

You will work closely with Beacon project leads, data architects, and client stakeholders to shape analytics requirements, build robust data models, and deliver insights that directly inform strategy and operations.

Qualifications

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS (MUST HAVES)

3+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or related roles
Advanced proficiency in SQL for analysis and analytics data modeling
Experience building dashboards and reports in BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar
Experience working with modern data transformation or orchestration tools (e.g., dbt, ADF, SSIS, Airflow)
Working knowledge of Python for data analysis, automation, or advanced analytics tasks
Experience operating within cloud data environments (AWS or Azure; Snowflake preferred)
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
Eligibility to work in the United States

Preferred Qualifications (nice To Haves)

Experience mentoring or guiding junior analysts
Strong understanding of relational database principles and data modeling
Experience working with CRM, ERP, marketing, or operational systems
Comfort working with structured and semi-structured data sources
Client-facing experience, including presenting insights to non-technical audiences
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
High attention to detail and commitment to high-quality analytics outputs

WHAT YOU'LL DO
Beacon Data is seeking a talented, Business Intelligence Analyst/ Engineer to join our data team and help us solve complex and interesting problems for our diverse clients. Your Team Will

Lead the development of analytics-ready datasets and metrics that serve as a single source of truth
Analyze data from ERP, CRM, and other operational systems to answer complex business questions
Write and maintain production-quality SQL to transform, validate, and analyze data
Build and maintain dashboards and reports in BI tools that support executive and operational decision-making
Partner with business stakeholders to translate questions and hypotheses into structured analyses
Identify trends, patterns, and anomalies in data and communicate insights clearly
Support and collaborate on data pipeline and transformation work alongside data engineers and analytics engineers
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, documentation, and adherence to security best practices

Who You Will Work With

You will work under the strategic guidance of Beacon’s Senior Data Architect and receive day-to-day support from an experienced Senior Project Lead. You will collaborate closely with Beacon teammates and client-side analysts, engineers, and IT partners in an agile, team-based environment.

This is a highly collaborative role focused on building analytics solutions that enable better decision-making across organizations.

You are a curious, collaborative, and impact-driven analyst who enjoys turning complex data into clear insights. You thrive in dynamic environments and enjoy balancing technical rigor with business context.

new_jobs.description:
Merge is the leading provider of agentic tools and customer-facing integrations for frontier LLMs, Fortune 500 organizations, and B2B SaaS companies. Our platform offers three core products: Merge Unified, which enables businesses to add hundreds of integrations to their products with a single API, Merge Agent Handler, which empowers AI agents with secure access to thousands of third-party tools, and Merge Gateway, the control plane for running AI in production. Merge's enterprise-grade platform handles the entire integration lifecycle, from authentication and security to monitoring and maintenance. Thousands of companies trust Merge to accelerate product development, unblock sales, reduce customer churn, and save engineering resources—allowing them to focus on their core product.

Who are we looking for?

We're a high-growth Series B company selling into a fast-moving AI and developer ecosystem where the market changes weekly and a finding that's interesting today is table stakes in a month. We move quickly, we work hard, and we care a great deal about being right.

We're hiring a Data Analyst to find the insights that drive our growth. You'll work directly with leadership on product and market strategy, shape how we make decisions as an engineering team, and influence how Merge presents itself to the world. If you want to dig into data no one has looked at, find the thing worth saying, and have your analysis be the reason we went left instead of right, this is the role.

What will you be doing?

Dig into our product, customer, and market data to find patterns worth acting on and raise questions before anyone else discovers them.
Work with engineering and design to build dashboards and frontend analytics that give customers a reliable view of what's happening in the product.
Partner with product marketing and sales to turn findings into campaigns, launch assets, and the numbers behind the pitch + the methodology to back them up.
Field requests from across the business and decide what warrants a deep dive, a quick pass, or a later response.
Analyze product usage data (onboarding funnels, feature adoption, dashboard engagement) to identify opportunities to improve the customer journey.
Turn one-off analyses into repeatable internal tools and self-service resources so the next request is faster than the last.

What experience is required?

Degree in data science, computer science, statistics, or a similar quantitative field.
2+ years in analytics, data science, insights, or a technical GTM / BizOps role.
Strong SQL. You write clean, structured queries on large datasets, and whether you wrote them yourself or an AI assistant did, you own the correctness of every result before it reaches a stakeholder.
Working knowledge of dbt. You'll use and extend existing models without needing to own a full warehouse build.
Working Python for analysis and automation, including AI-enabled workflows that reduce manual reporting overhead.
Writing that carries a finding. You can take an analysis and produce something a marketer, a seller, or a customer reads once and understands.

Nice to have

Experience at a B2B SaaS or developer tools company, or anywhere with a real data asset
Background working closely with product, marketing, sales, and/or revenue operations
Hands-on experience with product analytics tools like PostHog, Mixpanel, or Amplitude.
Familiarity with LLM and AI infrastructure data, or a genuine interest in learning it fast

Compensation

The cash compensation range for this role is $150,000-170,000
Actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications. In addition to cash compensation, all employees receive an equity compensation package.

Andersen Corporation Summary

At Andersen, we see possibility everywhere, every day and in everything we do. The possibility for our employees to achieve their full potential, for our communities to be stronger and for everyone to have a healthier, happier place to live.

Overview

JOB DESCRIPTION:

The Program Coordinator helps keep the Business Transformation program organized and running smoothly. This role supports project teams by scheduling meetings, tracking tasks, maintaining documents, preparing communications, and helping teams stay on schedule.

Key Responsibilities

Schedule meetings and prepare agendas and materials.
Take meeting notes and track action items.
Maintain project schedules, task lists, and documentation.
Follow up with team members on deadlines and assigned work.
Create and distribute newsletters, updates, and team communications.
Organize SharePoint sites, files, and project records.
Prepare reports, presentations, and status updates.
Support onboarding, training coordination, and team events.
Manage stakeholder contact lists and communication distribution lists.
Assist project leaders with calendars, presentations, and administrative tasks.
Coordinate system access and training assignments for team members.

Qualifications

High school diploma or equivalent required.
2+ years of experience in an administrative, coordinator, office support, or customer service role.
Strong organizational and time management skills.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Experience with Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, or similar collaboration tools preferred.

Pay Range

$24.95 - $36.15
